summary: Jenkinsfile.iac-image now guards its build stage with utils.hasChanges over the five image inputs the Dockerfile actually reads (support/iac-image/.*, pyproject.toml, poetry.lock, homelab-root.crt, known_hosts.d/homelab), marking the stage skipped for conditional otherwise; import, checkout scm, Dockerfile path, context and both tags follow the HelmCharts/DockerImages pattern with no escape hatch added.
